description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Buff Ice 30% (15s)], [Buff Water 30% (15s)], [Awoken Wisdom], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Ice-touched Water Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Buff Ice 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Water 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Water damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Awoken Wisdom
description.text: Ice and Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Ice-touched Water Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Ice-touched Water after using two Ice or Water abilities
